question: How many sanskrit plays were written by Harshavardhana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harshavardhana wrote three Sanskrit plays: Nagananda, Ratnavali, and Priyadarshika: **
 
• Harshavardhana **was an Indian emperor and poet who ruled North India from 606 to 647 CE.**
 
• He was a great patron of the arts and learning
 
• He is the **Son of Prabhakaravardhana, king of Thanesar, and younger brother of Rajyavardhana **
 
• He is praised by the Chinese Buddhist traveller Xuanzang in his writings 
 
• An inscription of Harsha from 631 AD was found in Madhuban, Uttar Pradesh
